steps.en: Install Flint and the browser Vega-Lite renderer stack
steps.zh: 安装 Flint 与浏览器 Vega-Lite 渲染依赖

steps.en: Supply rows, field meanings and x/y mappings for the monthly chart
steps.zh: 提供逐行数据、字段含义与月度图的横纵轴映射

steps.en: Pass the complete input to the assembler
steps.zh: 把完整输入交给编译接口

steps.en: Resolve semantics and layout into a native Vega-Lite specification
steps.zh: 推导字段含义与布局，输出绘图库原生规格

steps.en: Render the generated specification with Vega-Embed to display the chart
steps.zh: 用 Vega-Embed 渲染生成规格，显示图表

value.en: Reuse field meanings instead of hand-writing axes and layout for each chart
value.zh: 复用字段含义，不为每张图手写坐标与布局
